description: Add or change the dietary note on an order before it's paid (an allergy, an intolerance, in the user's words), at a shop that takes dietary notes. An empty note removes it. The order's card shows it within a few seconds. Once the order is paid it's with the shop already: the user tells staff at the counter instead.

claim.description: The claim create_pickup_order returned with the order.

note.description: The note, only what the user said. Empty to remove it.

shop_url.description: An agentPickup shop's URL, as find_shops returns it. Defaults to https://agentpickup.app.

name: set_dietary_note
title: Add a dietary note
